title: Applying for a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card
summary: Find out about the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card (CSHC) for eligible Australians who have reached pension age.
intro:
A Commonwealth Seniors Health Card (CSHC) is available for eligible Australians who have reached pension age.

Holders of a CSHC receive concessions on certain medical expenses, and depending on their individual GP, that may also include having visits to their doctor, bulk billed.

In addition, most state/territory and local councils will provide cost of living benefits to card holders.

To be eligible for a CSHC, you must not be receiving any income support from Centrelink or the Department of Veterans' Affairs, and meet other criteria relating to your residency status and income.

Note: The CSHC is provided by Services Australia, not Service NSW.
